archetypes.name: ci-wait-failclosed
archetypes.rationale: The CI delegate now treats ambiguous wait output as terminal exhaustion.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the delegated CI fixer cycle transitions. Focus on wait output parsing, stale run-id reuse, and whether every fail-closed path clears next_run_id while preserving recovery checkpoints. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: conflict-guard
archetypes.rationale: Conflict fixers now revert protected deltas before accepting a tier.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the conflict-resolution forbidden-path guard. Check snapshot timing, revert ordering, reset behavior, and that pre-push handoff remains independent from guard-triggered stalls. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ci-monitor-trim
archetypes.rationale: The old in-process CI waterfall was removed from run_ci_fix.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the CI monitor routing after trimming run_ci_fix. Confirm normal failures still delegate through the agentic fixer, pending rebase retries still force-push only after verification, and remaining helper references are intentional. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
